run_f_gold: run f_gold to count ways to express n as a sum of 1, 3, and 4
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple inputs and compare results with the filled solution
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that counts ways to express n as a sum of 1, 3, and 4
review_f_gold: review the f_gold DP recurrence relation using DP[i-1], DP[i-3], and DP[i-4]
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use memoization instead of a bottom-up DP array
